versions.changelog:
No changes detected in this release.

- Version bumped to 1.0.1 without any file modifications.
- All content and features remain as in the previous version.

Initial release of the Botpress ADK skill.

- Provides a comprehensive guide for building AI bots with the Botpress Agent Development Kit (ADK).
- Includes usage scenarios, setup instructions, ADK CLI installation, and troubleshooting steps.
- Explains ADK project structure and conventions, emphasizing the importance of file placement.
- Offers quick reference tables and a component decision guide for different bot features.
- Clarifies the AI-native approach of ADK, moving away from traditional intent/entity/dialog patterns.
- Contains links to official documentation and GitHub resources for further details.
